name: Dreadfauns
text: On play, spawn 2 Satyrs with 2/2/3/3/4 strength on random bordering tiles

name: Pillars of Doom
text: At the start of your turn, deal 2/2/3/3/4 damage to the enemy base

name: Xuri, Lord of Life
text: On play, fly to the first empty tile in front. Give 3/4/5/6/7 strength to all friendly units passed and vitalize them.

name: Herald’s Hymn
text: Give 1/2/3/4/5 strength to a target friendly unit. Command all friendly units in its row forward.

name: Queen of Herds
text: On play, randomly play up to 1/1/1/2/2 common or rare Satyr/Satyr/Satyr/Satyrs/Satyrs from your deck on a tile in its row

name: Vindicators
text: Before attacking, deal 1/1/1/2/2 damage to the enemy base

name: Lasting Remains
text: After attacking, move forward

name: Head Start
text: Spawn a 3/4/5/6/7 strength Satyr on a random tile in your furthest row

name: Petrified Fossils
text: After surviving damage, command all friendly units with equal or less strength forward

name: Bucks of Wasteland
text: After surviving damage, randomly give strength to 2 other friendly units equal to the damage received

name: Temple of Focus
text: At the start of your turn, deconfuse and give 1 additional move to all friendly units in front

name: Diehards
text: When dying from an ability or spell, respawn on a random surrounding tile with 4/6/8/10/12 strength

name: Martyr Spongers
text: Before moving deal 1/1/1/2/2 damage to 1/2/2/3/3 other friendly ancient units, then deal the same amount of damage to enemy’s base

name: Icicle Burst
text: Freeze a target enemy unit. If it is already frozen, deal 8/10/12/15/18 damage to it instead

name: Frosthexers
text: On play, freeze all bordering enemy units

name: The Hearth
text: At the start of your turn, give 2/2/3/3/4 strength to another friendly unit or structure

name: Wisp Cloud
text: Before attacking a frozen enemy, deal 4/5/6/7/8 damage to all surrounding frozen enemies

name: Yowling Weavers
text: When attacking, randomly destroy a friendly non-Dragon unit

name: Moment’s Peace
text: Give 5/6/7/8/9 strength to a target friendly unit or structure. Freeze all surrounding enemy units.

name: Mystwives
text: When played bordering a stronger friendly unit, gain 4/5/6/7/8 strength

name: Spellbinder Zhevana
text: On play, destroy all frozen units in front with 4/5/6/7/8 or less strength. Gain 4 mana for each unit destroyed.

name: Frozen Core
text: At the start of your turn, gain 2 mana

name: Lady Rime
text: On play, spend your remaining mana and gain 2/2/3/4/5 strength for each

name: Midwinter Chaos
text: Freeze all enemy units with 4/5/6/7/8 or less strength. Destroy those that were already frozen.

name: Rimelings
text: On play, gain 3 mana

name: Rockworkers
text: On play, build a 4/5/6/7/8 strength Fort on a random bordering tile

name: Blessed with Brawn
text: Give 8/10/12/15/18 strength to a target friendly unit or structure with 4/5/6/7/8 or less strength

name: Broken Earth Drakes
text: When this dies not bordering any base, deal 3/4/5/6/7 damage to all non-Dragon units

name: Dawnsparks
text: When attacking, gain 4 mana

name: Wolfcloaks
text: On play, lose 1 strength for every other friendly unit on the board

name: Fleshmenders
text: On play, give 6/7/8/10/12 strength to a random bordering friendly unit or structure

name: Visions of the Grove
text: On play, for every 4/4/3/3/2 remaining mana deal 1 damage to all enemies in front

name: Chillbeards
text: Before attacking a unit or structure, gain 3/4/5/6/7 strength

name: Olf the Hammer
text: When played bordering your base, give it 3/3/4/5/6 strength

name: Underground Spring
text: At the start of your turn, remove 1/1-2/1-2/2/2 strength from itself and give it to your base

name: Earthfathers
text: After surviving damage, gain 3/3/3/4/4 strength

name: Chilled Stonedames
text: After surviving damage, destroy all enemy units in front

name: Temple of Life
text: At the start of your turn, vitalize 1/2/2/3/3 friendly unit/units/units/units/units, then spawn a 1 strength copy of itself on the tile behind

name: Glacier Palace
text: At the start of your turn, randomly freeze the most forward enemy unit

name: Iceflakes
text: On play, freeze itself

name: Blizzard Bombs
text: On death, freeze all surrounding units

name: Orgone Leechers
text: Before moving, reduce mana by 3, then freeze an enemy in the tile in front. Decrease mana reduction by 1 for each other friendly ancient on the board.

name: Fragmented Essences
text: Before moving, split its strength equally into a unit on both sides. Cannot split again for this movement.
